methodological_conclusions: Dimension-seven sterile scalar-derivative strength classes provide a structural target for the packet chiral image, but coefficient matching requires full conventions.
Use an explicitly defined curvature projector and derive its sign locally; no F_L/F_R source label or coefficient is transferred.
Zero-N polynomial slicing of a retained-field action is not heavy-sterile elimination and need not commute with an interacting EoM field map.
Complex symmetric Majorana mass transformations use congruence; M M-dagger and M-dagger M act on distinct chiral spaces.
Helicity-selection theorems require physical-basis, massless, length, Yukawa and scheme premises not established by a raw chiral projection.
limitations: Only specified body sections were checked; no complete paper or supplement was exhaustively reviewed.
Other search records received abstract-level screening only.
No source coefficient, beta-function entry, loop formula or process-specific phenomenological bound was imported.
A raw5/3 K_S derivative coefficient remains a representative coordinate coefficient, not a physical renormalization result.
Reference interactions must be named when asserting completeness of a zero-sterile slice.
